primitives.note: Q, W, E deal damage on cast or after a fixed cast/travel delay on their own cooldowns; R's own missile deals no self-damage but arms the wake-up bonus (see conditional-damage).

Dream-Laden Bough: any Lillia ability that hits an enemy applies 'Dream Dust', a 3s/6-tick DoT dealing 5% (+1.25%/100AP) of the target's max HP total, capped vs monsters. Triggered by Q/W/E hits and by R's wake-up damage (R's sleep application itself does not apply it).

Q deals bonus true damage equal to its magic damage only to targets caught within the outer ring (225-485 range) of the swing; W deals 3x damage to targets caught in a 65-radius epicenter sweet spot. The dummy fight must assume whether the target is standing in these zones for every cast.

R puts an enemy champion drowsy (1.5s) then asleep (2s, after a 0.3s missile travel); the next non-persistent damage instance a sleeping target takes from a champion/large monster/turret consumes the debuff for bonus magic damage (100-200 + 40% AP). Requires the target to already be marked by Dream Dust to cast R at all, and requires a follow-up qualifying hit to land while asleep to realize the bonus.

Mana costs (Q 65, W 50, E 70, R 50) with no listed mana-restore mechanic on the kit; over a 15s fight with no items/runes assumed, mana could cap the number of casts, especially with W/Q on short (4-14s) cooldowns and E fixed at 12s.

needsBespoke.why: The kit's damage-relevant mechanics (base ability damage, an ability-triggered percent-max-HP DoT shared across all four abilities, positional bonus-damage zones on Q and W, and R's 'next hit while asleep' bonus damage) are all expressible as combinations of plain-cast, dot, positional-assumption, and conditional-damage primitives; no unique stat-conversion, form-change, ammo, or pet logic is needed for the damage fight.

unsettled.question: When Dream Dust is already active on the target and a second Lillia ability hits it, does the new hit simply refresh the existing 3s/6-tick DoT (one DoT instance total), or does it start a fully independent second DoT instance that stacks/ticks alongside the first?
options: Refresh only: re-applying Dream Dust resets the 3s timer but there is still only one DoT running at a time
Stacking: each ability hit creates its own independent 3s/6-tick DoT instance, so overlapping casts multiply total Dream Dust damage

unsettled.question: Lillia's Dream Dust self-heal-per-level curve disagrees between the bin's LilliaP#ChampionHeal byLevel(1..15) array (times 6 ticks) and the wiki's stated pplevel quadratic formula (6..90) — which curve is authoritative for computing sustain in the survival fight?
options: Use the bin's byLevel(1..15) array x 6 ticks
Use the wiki's stated pplevel formula 6 + ((90-6)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))

unsettled.question: W's effective delay before impact disagrees between sources: the bin's LilliaW.MaximumCastTime is 0.75s flat, while the wiki states cast time as 'None' with an actual pre-impact delay of 0.6 to 0.75s depending on dash distance (rounded to the next game tick, up to 0.767s). Which value should gate how often W can deal damage in the 15s window relative to its cooldown?
options: Treat W as always taking the maximum 0.75s (or 0.767s per the note) delay before impact
Treat W's delay as variable (0.6-0.75s) depending on assumed cast distance to the stationary dummy
quotes: Dash starts immediately before a 0.25 cast time, but actual delay is 0.6 to 0.75 seconds
cannot move before the strike goes off at {{fd|0.767}} seconds, regardless

unsettled.question: E's cast time disagrees between the bin (LilliaE castTime = 0.35) and the wiki (0.4) — which is the live value for pacing E's casts in the rotation?

proposal: Open with E (Swirlseed) at 0.4s cast to land the first Dream Dust application on the dummy and begin its DoT.
Immediately follow with Q (Blooming Blows), positioning so the dummy is caught in the outer ring for both the magic and bonus true damage, refreshing/stacking Dream Dust.
Cast W (Watch Out! Eep!) aiming for the epicenter sweet spot for 3x damage, again applying/refreshing Dream Dust.
Once the dummy carries a Dream Dust mark, cast R (Lilting Lullaby); it has 0.4s cast + 0.3s travel + 1.5s drowsy before the dummy falls asleep (~2.2s after R is cast).

During R's drowsy window, keep recasting Q on its short cooldown (4-6s) and weave basic attacks; time a qualifying non-persistent hit (an autoattack or another ability cast) to land the instant the sleep debuff is live, so it consumes the debuff for R's bonus magic damage.

For the remainder of the 15s window, recast Q every time it comes off cooldown (highest priority, cheapest, shortest CD), fire E every 12s, W every 10-14s, and fill any gaps with basic attacks, tracking mana against the ~235 mana used per Q+W+E+R cycle.
R itself will not come off cooldown again inside 15s (110-150s CD), so it is cast once, as early as its prerequisite (a Dream Dust mark) allows.
questions: Does the simulator model Lillia performing basic attacks between ability casts in the damage fight, or is the rotation ability-casts-only? This changes whether R's wake-up bonus is best consumed by an autoattack or by weaving another ability cast into the ~2.2s drowsy window.

Should R be cast as early as possible (as soon as a Dream Dust mark exists, likely right after the opening E) to maximize the number of 15s-window ticks that benefit from its bonus damage, or held to guarantee no drowsy time is wasted while other cooldowns are down?

When multiple Dream Dust instances would be active/refreshing simultaneously (see unsettled question on stacking), does the optimal rotation change to spacing out casts (to avoid wasted overlap) versus stacking them as fast as possible?
